title: [Lean] Add physical compact-counter copy with a linear bound
body:
## Summary

Add one Lean source for an explicit nine-state, two-tape compact-counter copy. The input is a marked-home little-endian bit list; the output tape is pristine. The machine trims high zero bits and physically copies the retained bits into canonical `Tape.ofWord` form, including exactly empty output for empty/all-zero input.

For input length `n` and compact length `m`, the proved run index is `2*n+3` when the compact list is empty and `2*n+2*m+4` otherwise, always at most `4*n+4`. Both final tape footprints and the halted state are specified. The source tape retains its represented boundary and cleared high cells.

## Verification and reuse

- One unchanged new source, 26,462 bytes, with five exact external sources pinned to PR488 and PR511. Their merger is not assumed.
- Lean 4.21.0, 1,300 hash-pinned official core modules; no Mathlib or downloads.
- Reproduction retained five verified public prerequisite outputs and freshly checked the compact root in 3.740048218 compiler seconds, with 0.000447221 seconds FIFO and 1,729,921,024-byte peak VM. All six reference objects, full logs and 41 complete standard-only axiom probes match.
- The README distinguishes this measured five-retained/one-fresh sequence from the supported fresh six-source command. Resource limits, provenance, exact dependencies, LICENSE and NOTICE are included.

## Author-checked source context and limits

At pinned selected-result context `f19cb621be2caf3a7291a37c343c1c55afe935e0`, the explicitly author-checked conditional project value is

`kappa = 1517760977820331 / 1000000000000000000 = 0.001517760977820331`.

The author checked the exact rational/decimal equality and the selected-result hash linkage to `research/community-pr531-audit/direct-ASSEMBLY.json`. The new branch is based on `db0e57bc7f36b5ac0fc844ad7ce1396165ee6647`; the publisher reports unchanged selected-result/certificate, licensing, existing Lean and toolchain identities from f19. The selected record reports finite-package replays while retaining conditional all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-basis, normalized residual realization, correlated whole-owner hosting, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer interfaces. Its historical research ceilings are not independently certified by that integration. This package does not replay those finite packages or prove their construction-specific interfaces; it establishes no multiplier or kappa theorem.

The generic compact-copy theorem, exact immutable source dependencies and accepted reproduction are unchanged. The earlier `12a4934` and `4d18ff5` author contexts remain preserved. The delivered selected-result, linked certificate, changed-path and licensing evidence, together with the approved proof/review packet, support this conditional-context readback; no finite replay or construction-specific tape implementation is claimed.

Numeric value/logarithmic-length adapters and the later six-tape caller are separate work, outside this package. There is no first-completion claim or new generic increment/amortization result. No inherited root file is changed.

## Repository checks and AI disclosure

Substantial AI assistance was used to develop and check this contribution. The affected Lean reproduction and complete axiom-probe evidence are listed above. No upstream source, generator or root certificate is modified. The repository also requires `make verify` and `make gen4-bank-verify`; their exact new-head outcomes will be recorded separately, and are not represented by the historical package-only reproduction. No fresh aggregate result is claimed yet.
